schema.title: Nemo staged native application transport v2
schema.description: N15 machine-readable contract. Host discovery is N16 and authority activation is N20.
Preserve existing opaque bytes. Numeric indices are not IDs; string syntax cannot establish provenance or uniqueness.
A finite [x, y] pair.
Open or closed cubic anchors with ordered relative handles; closure is independent of the anchors.
Explicit null is no fill; absent is refused.

hasRealStroke is authoritative and true exactly when stroke is not null; a fallback colour is never an authored stroke. The owner also requires a positive finite dash length. miterLimit, dashArray, dashOffset and paintOrder keep absent distinct from explicit values.
t must not decrease along the profile.
Presence is the vector-brush flag. There is no pressure scalar; the visible ribbon is the record geometry and a ribbon has no real stroke.
Stored parametric intent of a dynamic rect, ellipse or star; box is the stored frame the anchors were built from.

skippedSteps.description: Batch only, and only when the request set skipUnavailable: how many restyle steps were skipped (their ids are still listed, naming their targets).

schema.description: Compact vector edit receipt: the stroke an owner allocated (create) or the stable target named (replace, delete, mask.edit). Parameter and path-effect edits answer with the compact CommandResult.

Prepared success contract only: outer contentRevision equals expectedRevision + 1. Retained replay proves historical creation identity, not current presence after undo. Public execution remains unavailable until native readers and caller policy are accepted.
Authored stable native identity. The owner enforces at most 128 UTF-8 bytes; the string syntax cannot establish provenance or uniqueness.
Authored stable native identity. The owner enforces at most 128 UTF-8 bytes and no NUL; the string syntax cannot establish provenance or uniqueness.
Authored stable native identity. The owner enforces at most 128 UTF-8 bytes and no control character; the string syntax cannot establish provenance or uniqueness.
Editor layer selection by stable layerUid. The compact receipt does not carry the resulting selection; adapters rebuild it from the post-revision projection.

Importer-chosen handle: at most 255 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL, not blank, unique per kind inside one batch. maxLength counts code points and is only a coarse character bound; the byte bound is enforced by the Rust and JS validators. The owner maps it to a minted native id and never persists it.

Compact receipt: outer contentRevision equals expectedRevision plus one iff applied. Every declared layer, vector/raster/text object, retained asset, source asset and skip is accounted for. Optional assets maps retained assets then sources in declaration order to newly minted assetIds and is omitted by the owner when empty. The serialized result is limited to 3072 bytes.

Bounded actual successful native presentation discovery. The unchanged complete-envelope limit is 4096 bytes. Rust correlates atRevision with the request and outer contentRevision and requires native-object:<documentId>:<atRevision>; the host supplies the actual context, frame, work and view generation. Historical generator absent; this additive shape is source-derived.
Staged immutable common-envelope result: atRevision equals outer contentRevision; snapshot token is native-object:<documentId>:<atRevision>. Complete envelope is limited to 4096 bytes.

Source-derived bounded immutable image-mesh view. The complete envelope remains limited to 4096 bytes. Rust validates exact request/presentation/snapshot and full target correlation, held source frame <= presented frame, metadata/count relationships, triangle bounds and cursor progress; JSON Schema shape acceptance alone does not prove them.

The Solo view of the layers (baseline layerIsEffectivelyVisible): while any listed layer belongs to the exported context only the listed layers, and the children of a listed folder layer, are exported, whatever their eyes say. Strictly ascending (so unique): an ordering rule the JSON Schema cannot express, repeated by the contract. A session view fact, never document data; absent or empty means no solo.
Codec-validated native subset, never legacy v13 packaging. The complete encoded response is limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes; oversized reads fail unavailable without truncation.
Pure immutable snapshot evaluation. The complete encoded response is limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes; oversized reads fail unavailable without truncation.

Repeat-only immutable native preparation counts, retained after successful commit and on exact replay. Counts describe visited/skipped layers, not whether the document changed; all-component timeline growth can apply with zero cycled layers.
Native detached packet; aggregate serialized records plus complete orderElements arrays <=4194304 UTF8 bytes, independently of full correlated envelope. Runtime validators enforce byte accounting.

Native retained clipboard result; inner instance/document must match invoking owner; null means no new packet. Operation-specific complete original UTF8 envelope limit5246976; native serialized record+complete order-array data limit4194304; cell/container reserve1048576 and correlated-header reserve4096. Runtime byte admission, not JSON character length, enforces these limits. Other operations retain4096.

Native retained clipboard result; inner instance/document must match invoking owner; null means no new packet. Operation-specific complete original UTF8 envelope limit5246976; native serialized record+complete order-array data limit4194304; cell/container reserve1048576 and correlated-header reserve4096. Runtime byte admission, not JSON character length, enforces these limits. Other operations retain4096.
Bounded stored baseline fillGradient. Document-world coordinates and stop/color order retained; item/layer opacity folds once in native style production. Other stop counts remain unavailable.

Ordinary Move actual native destination cells after locks/crop/ripple. Eligible checkpoint publishes true/1 even if bytes unchanged; early no-op false/0/null preserves UI selection. Complete correlated reply is admitted before commit.

markers.description: The layer's own markers in frame order, as printed while they fit the read (the baseline snap targets); absent without any.

effectKeys.description: Every frame with a key on the layer's effect stack, ascending and unique, as printed while they fit the read; absent without any.

keyFrames.description: The frame of every key on the layer's own property holders (the layer and its elements), ascending, one entry per key and so repeated where keys share a frame, as printed while they fit the read; absent without any.

value.description: The eased source frame at the read's frame; null without keys.

keys.description: The keys in frame order while the read fits its bound; null past it (keyCount still counts them).

color.description: The key tint (#rrggbb or #rrggbbaa) when the key carries one.

hold.description: True when the key holds its value to the next key; absent otherwise.

sourceFrameCount.description: T12: the source frame count of the desktop host's decode session bound to this placement and snapshot, as the decoder defines it; null when no session is bound or the count is unknown.

placement.description: T12: the layer's video drawing placement, or null. Remap keys are listed while the read stays within 4096 bytes and counted always.

cells.description: Runs [startFrame, frameCount, cellKind, sourceFrame, hasContent, manualEdit] tile the page in order; each frame of a run answers the single-cell read identically, an interpolated frame being its own source (sourceFrame is the run start). nextFrame starts the next page, or null when the row is complete.

schema.description: Actual immutable identity and selected source; complete encoded result <=4096bytes or typed Unavailable. A core read is not live host/UI epoch admission or rendering/export acceptance.
Authored fillSeed/fillSeeds/fillWalls/fillGapPx provenance in the existing native vector record. Empty arrays and an explicit zero remain distinct from absence.

perspectiveMode.description: At most1024 UTF8 bytes; runtime enforces bytes without altering imported spelling.

flipX.description: A stored mirror about the item's centre (anchor for a text block); absent reads false.

flipY.description: A stored mirror about the item's centre (anchor for a text block); absent reads false.

skew.description: A stored x-shear in degrees about the item's centre (anchor for a text block); absent reads 0.

xformAnchorKey.description: The Select rotate/scale pivot preset the artist last chose for this item; a stored xformAnchorCustom wins over it.

xformAnchorCustom.description: The Select rotate/scale pivot as a custom world point [x, y].

brushGroupId.description: Native tag: at most 255 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; whitespace spelling is preserved.

meshId.description: Native tag: at most 255 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; whitespace spelling is preserved.

schema.description: Retained shape clipboard from the pinned native snapshot; clipboard contextId, layerUid and requested frame match the request. Complete encoded correlated response is limited to65536 bytes; overflow refuses before cut publication.

Retained shape clipboard from the pinned native snapshot; clipboard contextId, layerUid and requested frame match the request. Complete encoded correlated response is limited to65536 bytes; overflow refuses before cut publication.

strokeSeed.description: G16 option C: the anchor's stamping seed; native produces its dabs from it.

brushTexture.description: G16: the baseline serP brush-texture members of an anchor (preset, group, hidden paint) or a dab (copy flag, group).

pointTypes.description: Optional per-vertex point-type hint aligned with geometry.segments; absent means inferred from the handles. Never on a pressure ribbon.

xformAnchorKey.description: The Select rotate/scale pivot preset the artist last chose for this stroke; a stored xformAnchorCustom wins over it.

xformAnchorCustom.description: The Select rotate/scale pivot as a custom world point [x, y].

schema.description: Immutable stored vector extensions, including bitmap-anchor metadata. The native owner validates camouflage and linked-fill exclusion; no raster or resource bytes are returned here.
Immutable stored vector record returned by an object query. Generic vector create/replace retain ObjectVectorRecord and cannot write bitmap anchors.

pointTypes.description: The point type each listed vertex shows: its stored hint, else the one its handles show. Only on the plain editable read.

preview.description: #2255: the answer came from a candidate rig (a held pose drag).

matrix.description: #2255: the affine [a, b, c, d, e, f] (x' = a x + c y + e, y' = b x + d y + f) from the layer's own space, where every item is spelled, to the world (its Motion about its pivot, then every ancestor's). Null is the identity, and on every page after the first. The pivot is the centre of the layer's content bounds, the bound strokes posed by the (candidate) rig.

items.description: [bind, vertex, x, y, inX, inY, outX, outY, closed]: the posed outline of a bind (a stroke's segments with their relative handles, a mesh's contour with none), rounded to 0.01.
